articleTitle: Prospects of application of vacuum switch electronic devices in power electronics
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The modern power electronics based on use of semiconductors, which have a high switched current and a small voltage drop. At switching circuits with voltage of 20-200 kV their use becomes complicated because it is necessary of semiconductors with their control circuits series connection. It would be desirable to use in these cases the vacuum electronic tubes, capable to withstand high voltage switching. Advantage of vacuum devices is also the opportunity to limit short-circuit current and to work at the high frequencies. The limiting of vacuum electronic tubes application in power electronics are high power losses in conducting period.

articleTitle: Realization of a built-in self-test for integrated circuits based on reconfiguration
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The solution of built-in self-test based on Oscillation-BIST concept and oriented on usage together with analog and mixed-signal IC and taking into account tolerances on parameters of analog subcircuits' internal components has been proposed. The main attention has been paid to architecture of testing subcurcuit, realization of measurement circuit and the estimating oscillated frequency of circuit under test. The experimental results have been described for second-order active filter.

articleTitle: Modern methods and computer codes for modeling of high-frequency electromagnetic fields
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Main numerical methods for solving electromagnetic boundary value problems are described. Advantages and disadvantages of each method are discussed and modern means of their efficiency increasing are presented. Commercial computer codes implementing mentioned above numerical methods are listed and their main features are described and compared. In the conclusion main new challenges in the field of computational electrodynamics are presented and discussed.

articleTitle: A comparative analysis of computation methods of the power semiconductor diodes high harmonic spectrums
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The comparison of LF and HF radio interference voltage levels, generated by power semiconductor diodes in alternating-current circuit, which were computed by different methods, have been carried out. The diode diffusion and barrier capacitance simulation had been fulfilled.

articleTitle: Autonomous inverter based on single-phase modules
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The circuits of three-phase autonomous inerter based on single-phase modules are described in the article. The investigation was made for different type of inverter modules' control and load's junction.

publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering

articleTitle: Nanoreinforcing of slip rings for maintenance of an arch stabilisation and erosive firmness

abstract: It is done the review of processes of sliding slip rings wear process and their causing factors. It is shown the efficiency of a way of increase of slip rings wear resistance with welding with reinforcing by powders of boron carbide. The new design of a slip ring is offered.

articleTitle: Results of experimental researches high electronic efficiency Helix TWT in a two-frequency operating mode
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering

Features of amplitude-phase distortion are shown at such type of modulation of input power. The reasons of mutual amplitude and phase modulation in a spectrum of a traveling wave are discussed.

articleTitle: High power pulse modulator for vacuum microwave devices
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Structure optimization and the results of the functional modules development for high power modulator for klystrons, magnetrons, gyrotrons and other microwave vacuum devices are under discussion. Main goal is in the increasing of pulse form stability, breakdown protection and modulator's energy efficiency. The fields of preferable application for basic types of power switching devices in high power modulators are established.

articleTitle: Investigation of a three-gap resonator for powerful multibeam monotron

A magnetron generator that has multibeam structure and common three-gap resonator be able to provide high efficiency and output power, small overall dimensions and weight.

articleTitle: An deflector of the infrared rays based of concentration inhomogeneity in A3 B5 semiconductors

abstract: The effect of concentration inhomogeneity is analyzed for some semiconductors. In InSb this effect occurs under temperature-electrical instability in a magnetic field. In at GaAs-GaP compound, this effect is due to the built-in gradient of static dielectric permeability and electron flow grouping. This effect may be adapted to design an deflector of the infrared rays.

articleTitle: Electrodynamics analysis and synthesis of directional couplers on ridge waveguides with circular coupling aperture
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The analysis and synthesis of directional couplers on ridged waveguides through small circular apertures in common wide wall is carried out. Electromagnetic fields and cutoff wave numbers are calculated by method of partial regions including field singularities at the edge. For calculation of couple parameters the Bethe's quasi-static theory is used. The calculation results of 10 dB and 20 dB directional couplers are given.

articleTitle: Research of possibility of reception low dimensional systems with use of the phenomenon of self-organizing of the carbon adsorbate on monocrystal silicon

Solitary asperities at the surface are characterized by coefficient of kurtosis.

articleTitle: The double gap resonator oscillator with a buffer-amplifying stage

articleTitle: The sensitivity of sector double-gap cavities of multibeam klystron to deviation of geometric and electronic parameters

abstract: The idea of using of self-contained microprocessor applications for tracking and analysis of transient processes at the initiation of travelling-wave tube (TWT) by high-voltage power supply is proposed. articleTitle: The model of nonlinear non-stationary descrete interaction of the electron beams with the waves in a slow-wave structure
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: We describe the model of nonlinear non-stationary discrete electron-wave interaction in a finite segment of the slow-wave structure (SWS). It is based on the equation of excitation in the finite-differences 2-th order, which includes local coupling impedance and the electron beam current determined by averaging of local currents on the width of the gap. The method of large particles is used in current calculations. The algorithm and a results example are presented. The model can be used for simulating of the process of fixing of oscillations in the discrete SWS.

articleTitle: Development of a test-cradle for the p-i-n diode fhaseshifters
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Discrete phase-shifters are widely used in modern radars with phased-array antennas. So fast and exact measurement of phase-shifter parameters is important part of their production process. In the paper a design and parameters of the test-cradle for discrete p-i-n diode X-band phase-shifters are described.

articleTitle: Design of definition method of attenuation distribution in spiral slow-wave structures of TWT

articleTitle: Birth of millimetric nanostructural medicine — Nanotechnologies the future in radio-electronic biomedicine

articleTitle: Development of methods of mathematical modeling of transiet wave processes in the extended ring resonators microwave devices
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: There has been constructed mathematical model and carried out analysis of the transition processes in the in the extended ring resonators microwave devices. There has been investigated influence of the amount and position of the generators in the resonator, and cavity loss to the uniformity of the effective current of the electric field in the resonator.

articleTitle: Voltage drop in switch high-voltage vacuum electronic devices
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Now high-voltage switch devices find wider application in the powerful high-voltage electrotechnical equipment. Alongside with use of vacuum circuit-breakers with a mechanical drive there was a need for the high-speed switch device on the basis of electronic devices. For the decision of a problem of creation of a high-speed high-voltage switch it is expedient to use vacuum electronic devices. In particular, the individual vacuum device is capable to switch high voltage (up to 200 kV) while, for switching such voltage with semi-conductor devices it is required series connection of several tens devices. It is obvious, that reliability of such system will be inversely proportional to quantity of series connected semi-conductors. The vacuum high-voltage device possesses greater operation speed in comparison with semi-conductor, it is capable to work at temperature up to 300° C, moreover it withstand breakdowns and electromagnetic interferences. However, the basic obstacle for wide use of vacuum devices as a switch is the big direct voltage drop on opened device. The principle of deceleration of electron beam is used to decrease a direct voltage drop on the anode. The present work is devoted to questions of reduction of a direct voltage drop on the vacuum electronic switch device.

articleTitle: The independent fixture for illumination of staircases of buildings

From these grafics it is visible, that depth of modulation reaches an order of 80 %, and half-wave voltage 100-160 V.

In this paper, the model of Bragg grating consisting of periodical layers with Kerr nonlinearity is considered. The dynamic of electromagnetic wave propagation in nonlinear Bragg grating is numerically studied. The possibility of propagation of the signal which frequency lie within the band gap was demonstrated.

articleTitle: Analyse and design of a push-push oscillator in S-band
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: In this paper, a new method for generation of microwave and mm-wave power is introduced which is based on combination of two or more active elements' output (the fundamental frequency oscillators). The push-push design approach enables higher frequency operation, lower noise performance, and smaller size, which is attractive for microwave and mm-wave frequency source applications. This compact structure can be used in integrated circuits easily. Theory, analysing method and designing procedure of a push-push oscillator is discussed in this work.

articleTitle: The high-voltage stabilized power supply of the polarizable converter of expenditure
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The scheme and principle of work of the high-voltage power supply with the two-cascade scheme of the setting generator is considered. The developed power supply is used in structure of the polarizing converter of the charge of environments with a high capacitivity.

articleTitle: Optimisation of the nomenclature of a warehouse on the basis of proportional dependences
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: In article the problem of filling of a warehouse of trading firm on the basis of the task of proportional dependences for a number of independent parametres of the goods of trade dares.

articleTitle: Mechanisms impregrated emission cathodes
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: It is shown that the issue centres of the cathode are interphase borders of alumínate and tungsten in a time. Issue properties worsen as a result of decrease in activity of barium in process of course of phase reactions and increase of activity of oxygen in the device. The analysis percolation cathode models shows that in the field of working temperatures such system is self-regulated, i.e. phase structure and a temperature mode will be co-ordinated.

articleTitle: Trajectories analysis for an optimal regime of carsinotrode
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The non-stationary model and its program realization for simulating carsinotrodes show the opportunity of a considerable increase of the efficiency η. The four main parameters are chosen for the optimal variant with η=82 % and the phase trajectories are presented for several time moments. The physical explanation of such high efficiency are considered.

articleTitle: A millimeter waveband monolithic limiter
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Design of a millimeter waveband limiter for low-noise amplifiers is presented. The limiter base elements are monolithic GaAs p-i-n diode matrices. The device provides amplifier availability up to m30 W input power at no more than 10 mW leaked power.

articleTitle: Modified algorithm for data transmission based on nonlinear oscillator
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: In the present work the modified algorithm for data transmission is presented. The proposed algorithm is based on asymmetrical hardware solution with analog transmitter and digital receiver. The main features of modified algorithm is described.

articleTitle: Dynamics partial pressure gassing during pumping Wed
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The partial gas release during pumping is considered as a weakly nonequilibrium process and describes the methods of linear nonequilibrium thermodynamics. Streams are linear functions of thermodynamic forces. Force is the relationship of affinity reactions to the gassing temperature parts. As the flows accepted flows constituting the gas phase. The coefficients of proportionality determined from the kinetic of the processes of adsorption, desorption and diffusion. Mutual influence of the electrodes (the transfer of impurities) is taken into account cross-coefficients.

articleTitle: Cluster approach modelling digital devices on programm emulator NI ELVIS
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: This article deals with investigation cluster approach modelling digital devices on programm emulator NI ELVIS.

articleTitle: Improving the saturated efficiency of TWT C-band
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The results of calculation and experimental measures of helix C-band Traveling Wave Tube for space communications are described. Optimization of helix pitch and five stage depressed collector have allowed us to receive 63% of saturated efficiency and 41.5% of electron efficiency.

articleTitle: Synthesis of noncontact probes for charge and potential microdistribution measurement
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The solution of the noncontact probe synthesis problem is suggested. Some characteristics of the system are known: the distance between the probe and the research surface, the thickness of layers, the dielectric permittivity of layers. The layers are plane-parallel. The function, which describes transformation of surface charge or potential distribution into an electric signal, is equal 0 on the boundary surface except the probe plane. On this plane the function is unknown. The expressions for determination of this function on probe surface according to the given spatial transformation coefficients for charge or potential are received. It is possible to make this function by technical or (and) program means. The experimental results are considered.

articleTitle: Interference microwave fotometers of optical radiation parameters
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: In work is considered process of the interaction laser and microwave radiation with lumpy semiconductor which distribution concentration carriers depends on intensities of the laser radiation. It is shown that factors of the fading and reflections of the microwave radiation from plate of the semiconductor with photo generated carrier charge greatly hang from density of the flow to energy of the laser radiation. The possible design measuring devise parameter of the optical radiation is considered.

articleTitle: Features of phenomenological theory giant magnetoresistance in granular media ferromagnet — Nonmagnetic metal
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: An analysis of the applicability of the phenomenological model of giant magnetoresistance (GMR) in granular media ferromagnet-nonmagnetic metal. The dependences of GMR on the size of granules and the concentration of ferromagnetic phase. Derived requirements for the parameters of the medium when the effect is maximal.

articleTitle: Investigation of nanostructures properties' synthesized by no-current modification of monocrystal silicon
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: This article deals with investigation of nanostructures properties' synthesized by no-current modification of monocrystal silicon.

articleTitle: The analysis of propagation of acoustic plane waves in different crystals
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: By means of the offered analytical method the determinant relation for a phase velocities of elastic waves for an arbitrary propagation directions in a piezoelectric crystal are received. The phase velocities of three normal elastic waves for two crystals LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> and KNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> are calculated. Results of this calculation for each of waves are presented graphically in the form of the cards allowing easily to define phase velocities in any given direction in crystal. Therefore conclusions on use of the considered crystals for production of delay lines, with the best parameters can be done.

articleTitle: Multicritera estimation of efficiency of transforming complexes
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: In the report techniques of a multicriteria estimation of efficiency of transforming complexes are considered: data of an indistinct variant of the mechanism of limitations to an evolutionary method of generation alternatives and definition of weight coefficients on the basis of interrogation of the expert. The presented techniques are used at a choice of the equipment for transforming complexes.

articleTitle: 3D Computer simulation of field emission electron guns
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: 3-D computer simulation by Lorentz-EM software of field emission electron guns with the magnetic focusing for TWT, klystrons, gyro-TWT and magnetron-type devices is performed with regards its geometrical and experimental characteristics of the field emission array cathodes with micro- nanostructures.

articleTitle: The analisis of the sensitivity of characteristics to tolerances of the loop attenuating equalizer based on the coaxial and microstrip lines for broadband TWT
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: In the article the results of the sensitivity characteristics of the loop attenuating equalizer based on the coaxial and microstrip transmission line to production tolerances on the various elements of the design. Were considered attenuating equalizer different working frequency ranges. Degree of influence of tolerances of the various sizes of elements of a design on identity of characteristics is investigated.

articleTitle: Analog method of correction distortions of images, produced by laser acoustooptic microscope
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The possibilities of optical systems, used in order to eliminate are discussed distortions from laser acousto-optic microscope. Main parameters of these systems are calculated for example.

articleTitle: Experimental model of the converter on vacuum switch devices — EBV
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Opportunities of application of power high-current high-voltage electron beam valves (EBV) in reactive power static compensators in 50-60 Hz AC networks are considered. The scheme and design of 100 kW converter model on the basis of EBV are described. Experimental researches of work of model in the pulse-width modulation mode on frequency 2 kHz have allowed to define ways of creation of 1 MVA STATCOM.

articleTitle: Use of elektrets in low-current devices
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: On a elektret surface there is an electrode. An electrode close through loading with other electrode. The second electrode vibrates. The amplitude of a current in a contour is directly proportional to dielectric permeability of environment. The author suggests to insert into a backlash between a elektret and a vibrating electrode substance with huge dielectric permeability. The ceramics LSNO changes the permeability with frequency change a little. So it is possible to increase strongly a current in a chain.

articleTitle: Chaotic oscillations and their control in cascade klystron active oscillator with opposed electron beams
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: This work presents the results of experimental studies of complex dynamics of cascade klystron oscillator with delayed feedback. The main aim was to increase output power. The effect of chaotic signal suppression by an external harmonic signal was studied.

articleTitle: Dynamic current-voltage characteristics of nanoscale organic layers, produsing by combinations of planar technologies
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The metal-insulator-semiconductor structures were produced on silicon substrates by combination of planar technologies: Langmuir-Blodgett technique and polyion layer-by-layer self-assembly method. Thin organic films, consist of monomolecular layer of calixarenes and macromolecular layer of polyion, was an insulator. Electro physical properties of these structures were investigated by dynamic current-voltage characteristic method. The effect peculiarity of LB films deposition and LB film thickness and kind of metal ions on the shape of I-V curves at different frequencies of applied voltage has been established.

articleTitle: Solution of the TWT characteristic equation for the optimum interaction
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: An approximate solution for the characteristic equation presented in this paper made it possible to find relatively simple relations between the space charge and velocity parameters for the optimum interaction as well as for the boundaries of the interaction area. Approximate expressions for the maximum incremental rate and the optimum velocity parameter was also derived.

articleTitle: Program for calculating magnetic periodic focusing system«MPFS»
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The program for calculating magnetic periodic focusing system is presented. It has convenient for the device designers interface and information support for the methodology of calculation and description of the "MPFS" parameters.

articleTitle: Experimental investigation of a low-voltage vircator with preliminary modulation of a electron beam
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: In this paper a vircator (virtual cathode oscillator) is experimental investigated. It has a hot cathode, an accelerating anode, a control grid, a second anode, a reflector, a double-gap cavity. The two virtual cathodes are generated in this device. Such microwave oscillator with a virtual cathode will be useful for construction of the powerful microwave generators with electron efficiency approximately 30%.

articleTitle: EH-sensors as magnetometric sensors
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Showing a using by description of possibility of use EH-sensors as magnetometric sensors for weak signal reception.

articleTitle: Internal friction in metals research
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Solid body structure's internal friction measurement methods for the most part are very difficult in their practical realization. There the damped oscillation method was chosen because of its simplicity. In this paper for damped oscillation observation and registration on high temperatures designed plant's functional diagram is presented. The test's results demonstrate functionality of this plant and of the method we have chosen.

articleTitle: Ionic vetro-solar lantern of street illumination
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Now an actual problem became the organisation of systems of street illumination. The exit from a current situation sees in full refusal of use network and transition to a food from renewed energy sources. We develop the independent lantern of street illumination which are not connected in an industrial network, incorporated the advanced technologies and having long term of operation.

articleTitle: Welding inverter AC. influence of circuit reactive parameters on nature of transient processes
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The article deals about the problem of influence of welding inverter AC circuit reactive parameters on nature of transient processes, are electrical circuit of an inverter, its computer models, diagrams, obtained by simulation are graphs showing the dependence of the surge transistor inverter on parasitic parameters of the scheme, and the parameters of inverter's unlocking pulses.

articleTitle: Fabrication of magnetic nanostructures using atomic force microscopy
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Local anodic oxidation (LAO) of nickel, iron and cobalt films is experimentally studied. Most easy and efficient oxidation was found for iron where as the best repeatability was achieved for nickel films in the experiment. Threshold and optimal parameters for LAO on nickel and iron were determined.
